name: spellkave_map_graph
label: Map Graph
description: Render the authored place-graph as the shared spatial-graph view. Sources rows only through the same workspace/target/live resolution as spellkave_query (place_graphs, place_nodes, place_edges, actor_spatial_locations). output_type picks the ONE artifact computed and returned: 'svg' (default) — this tool's picture-first interactive use case: the raw SVG in details.svg plus an ImageContent PNG for hosts that render tool images (Pi TUI / Ghostty Kitty). 'utf8'/'ascii'/'braille' return that text variant in the like-named details field instead (no image). 'inventory' skips the graph picture entirely, details.inventory only. 'jpg' writes a backdrop-composed JPEG to output_dir/output_name and returns its path as details.jpg_path — no svg/ascii/utf8/braille text in the response.

graph.description: Optional place_graph_id filter — when set, draw that graph (any substrate). Omit to compose every outdoor positioned graph (world map).

slice.description: How to project multi-floor / unpositioned graphs: elevation_band (one floor), all_floors_offset (floors side-by-side), topology_only (adjacency layout), metric (all z in one plane), h3_world (outdoor multi-graph from cell_res10 — same plane idea as web WorldMapView). Omit for auto (indoor multi-z → elevation_band at z=0; outdoor compose uses h3 when cells present).

z_tolerance.description: Half-width of elevation_band in elevation units (default 0.5).

lod.description: structure = rooms/routes only (no occupancy badges); furnished = + actor counts (default).

output_type.description: Which single artifact to render — the engine computes ONLY this one (bead sk-due: the old `terminal` param picked the text body while the engine rendered svg + utf8 + ascii + braille + inventory regardless, every call). 'svg' (default) — this tool's own interactive picture-first use case: the raw SVG in details.svg plus an ImageContent PNG for hosts that render tool images (Pi TUI / Ghostty Kitty). 'utf8'/'ascii'/'braille' return that text variant in the like-named details field instead (no image). 'inventory' skips the graph picture entirely, details.inventory only. 'jpg' writes a backdrop-composed JPEG to output_dir/output_name and returns its path as details.jpg_path — no svg/ascii/utf8/braille text in the response.

output_dir.description: output_type='jpg' only; ignored otherwise. Directory to write the map-art JPEG into — absolute, or RELATIVE to the host process's own cwd. Optional: omit for a fresh temp directory (mkdtemp). Resolves this graph's authored [[map_layers]] backdrop (unmasked — same drawn-in-full contract every backdrop render in this package follows), rasterizes via resvg then encodes via ffmpeg -q:v 4, skipping the rewrite when an unchanged render already sits there (deterministic churn guard).

output_name.description: output_type='jpg' only; ignored otherwise. Base filename (no extension) for the JPEG written under output_dir. Optional: omit for a name derived from graph, or 'map' when graph itself is also omitted (a world-compose call).

target.description: Same read-only source override as spellkave_query (`workspace` | `local` | `live`). Omit for the default workspace+configured-target union.

promptSnippet: Draw the place-graph from existing query sources
promptGuidelines: Prefer spellkave_map_graph when you need a picture of place connectivity; badges are occupancy counts only.
Indoor/multi-floor: pass graph= and slice=elevation_band with z= (default auto z=0), or slice=all_floors_offset for side-by-side floors; topology_only when nodes lack positions.

Place graph + people: after spellkave_map_graph, call spellkave_query kind=entities fields=preferred and group by place_node_id (usually two calls). Optional third: place_nodes fields=preferred for labels.

Pass graph=<place_graph_id> to draw one graph; omit to compose every outdoor positioned graph (H3 plane when cell_res10 present). Deeper playbook only if needed: spellkave_docs doc=place-graph-occupancy.
Outdoor world: omit graph (or slice=h3_world) so CLI/agent map_graph matches web outdoor H3 placement methodology.
output_type=jpg to save a map-art file instead of an inline picture; utf8/ascii/braille/inventory are cheaper text-only reads when you don't need a picture at all.
